in_marathi.name: Balbhadra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Powerful and generous
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balbhadra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balbhadra is a Sanskrit name derived from two roots: 'Bal' meaning power and 'Bhadra' meaning generous. This name is attributed to Lord Vishnu, who is revered for his immense power and his generous nature towards his devotees.
